program_solutions:
(rule!
  (grid-from-fn h w
    (lambda (r c)
      (let ((v (cell-at g r c)))
        (if (and (= v 0)
                 (or
                   (and (> c 0) (< c (- w 1))
                        (= (cell-at g r (- c 1)) 4)
                        (= (cell-at g r (+ c 1)) 4))
                   (and (> r 0) (< r (- h 1))
                        (= (cell-at g (- r 1) c) 4)
                        (= (cell-at g (+ r 1) c) 4))))
            4
            v)))))
